title: Emotes / Layered game animation

location.extent: Representative frame; complete local motion provided

slide_intent: Use familiar play conventions to organize motion so visual variety can feel like participation rather than unrelated decoration.
strategic_value: A game-like arrangement of Glitch, emotes and score labels can connect Twitch’s graphic system with its gaming heritage.
demonstration: An animated rectangular playfield stacks into repeated outlined layers while emote arrangements, colors and labels such as Power-up!, Yoshi and Sonic change.
practical_value: Compare the stable playfield frame with the changing emotes, labels and palette before adding further moving elements.

content_islands.name: Foreground playfield
content_islands.spec: Keep a thin outlined rectangle with small Twitch identification, emotes and corner labels.

content_islands.name: Repeated layers
content_islands.spec: Offset copies of the playfield to create a rippling stack behind the front plane.

content_islands.name: Changing states
content_islands.spec: Change background hues, emote formations and score-like labels throughout the clip.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip combines emotes, game references, changing colors and a layered playfield effect.
